task.description: Implement IN-UI-09 (Active token visualisation) and IN-UI-10 (History scrubber) per the Type E prose designs. Both are SHOULD-priority features for the instance monitoring UI.
acceptance_criteria: ProcessGraphWithTokens component renders process graph with token markers
Token markers show active, completed, pending, and error states with colour coding
useProcessGraphWithTokens hook polls instance state every 2 seconds while active
HistoryScrubber component renders interactive timeline slider at top of Timeline tab
Scrubber supports click-to-jump, drag interaction, and keyboard navigation
Scrubbing to past events triggers state reconstruction and displays historical state
Live mode indicator and 'Resume live' button work correctly
All E2E tests pass against real backend
npx playwright test passes all tests

result.summary: Implemented IN-UI-09 (active token visualization) and IN-UI-10 (history scrubber) components with full feature support
